title: Topic 19
japanese_text: 親戚の集まりに行くと、姪っ子が待ち望んでいた子どもを授かったそうで、祝福<u>ムード</u>になっていた。私は姪っ子の体調を気遣って、<u>ささやか</u>だが妊婦用の腹巻きをプレゼントした。
english_translation: When I went to a family gathering, I heard that my niece had finally been blessed with the child she'd so eagerly awaited, and the mood was one of celebration. I was concerned for my niece's health, so I gave her a modest gift of a maternity tummy wrap.
